description: Linking words : addition, contraste, cause, conséquence, exemple, conclusion

questions.question: Correct spelling of the first linking word:
questions.explication: Firstly / First of all / To begin with / In the first place.

questions.question: Correct spelling:
questions.explication: Furthermore = de plus, en outre (registre soutenu).

questions.question: « Moretheless » does not exist. The correct word is:
questions.explication: Nonetheless = nevertheless = néanmoins. Les deux sont interchangeables.

questions.question: Which is the more formal way to say « on top of that »?
questions.explication: « On top of that » et « what's more » sont familiers ; à l'oral c'est très bien, à l'écrit préfère moreover.

questions.question: « However » expresses:
questions.explication: Souvent en début de phrase, suivi d'une virgule : However, the veto blocks reform.

questions.question: Which word introduces a consequence?
questions.explication: Therefore / thus / hence / consequently / as a result = donc, par conséquent.

questions.question: « So » in a formal essay is best replaced by:
questions.explication: « So » est correct mais familier à l'écrit.

questions.question: Correct pair:
choix: On the one hand… On the other hand…
On one hand… On other hand…
In one hand… In the other hand…
On the one hand… In the other hands…
questions.explication: « On one hand » est toléré, mais la forme complète est plus sûre.

questions.question: « Whereas » means:
questions.explication: The P5 have a veto, whereas the other members do not.

questions.question: « Although » is followed by:
questions.explication: Although the UN is criticized, it remains essential. Synonymes : though, even though.

questions.question: « Despite » and « in spite of » are followed by:
questions.explication: Despite the veto… / Despite being criticized… Mais : despite THE FACT THAT + sujet + verbe.

questions.question: Which expresses cause and is followed by a noun?
questions.explication: Because of the veto (nom) vs because the veto blocks decisions (proposition).

questions.question: Which linking words introduce an example?
questions.explication: Therefore introduit une conséquence.

questions.question: Which ones introduce a conclusion?
questions.explication: On peut aussi dire : to conclude, all things considered, ultimately.

questions.question: « Indeed » means:
questions.explication: The UN is weakened; indeed, the Security Council is often paralyzed.

questions.question: False friend: « eventually » means:
questions.explication: Pour « éventuellement », dis possibly ou perhaps.

questions.question: False friend: « actually » means:
questions.explication: Pour « actuellement », dis currently ou at present.

questions.question: « Yet » used as a linking word means:
questions.explication: The UN has no army, yet it maintains peace in many regions.

questions.question: « Besides » means:
questions.explication: Ne pas confondre avec « beside » (à côté de) au singulier.

questions.question: To add a second argument, the formal sequence is:
questions.explication: Variantes : first of all, then, next, lastly, last but not least.

questions.question: « As far as … is concerned » means:
questions.explication: Synonymes : regarding, concerning, with regard to, as for.

questions.question: « In other words » means:
questions.explication: Synonyme : that is to say (i.e.).

questions.question: « Not only… but also… »:
questions.explication: Attention à l'inversion si la phrase commence par Not only : Not only does the UN keep peace, but it also provides aid.

questions.question: « Meanwhile » means:
questions.explication: Autres marqueurs de temps : then, afterwards, since then, at the same time.

questions.question: « Admittedly » / « granted » are used to:
questions.explication: Admittedly, the UN is imperfect; however, it remains indispensable.

questions.question: « Thus » and « hence » mean:
questions.explication: Registre soutenu, fréquents à l'écrit.

questions.question: Which words express ADDITION?
questions.explication: However exprime un contraste.

questions.question: Which words express CONTRAST or CONCESSION?
questions.explication: Therefore exprime une conséquence.

questions.question: Which words express CONSEQUENCE?
questions.explication: Namely = à savoir (précision).

questions.question: To open an essay, which is best?
choix: To begin with / First of all

questions.question: « Since » can mean:
questions.explication: Since the Council is paralyzed, reform is discussed.

questions.question: « Last but not least » means:
choix: Enfin, et ce n'est pas le moins important

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
choix: Moreover, the UN faces a budget crisis
Moreover the UN face a budget crisis
In more of that, the UN faces a budget crisis
Moreover of that, the UN faces a crisis
questions.explication: Les connecteurs en tête de phrase sont suivis d'une virgule.

questions.question: Useful phrases to structure an argumentative essay:
questions.explication: « We can ask ourselves whether… » est correct mais lourd ; préfère one may wonder whether.
